functional_semantics: Credentials embedded in source/config/firmware that attackers can extract.
root_cause: Credentials embedded in source/config/firmware that attackers can extract.
fix_pattern: Externalize secrets (vault/KMS/env); no default or embedded credentials; rotate.
detection_hint: Indicators of Use of Hard-coded Credentials.

functional_semantics: A password is written directly into code.
root_cause: A password is written directly into code.
fix_pattern: Store hashed/managed secrets outside code; require configured credentials.
detection_hint: Indicators of Use of Hard-coded Password.

fix_pattern: Hash+salt at rest, TLS in transit, least exposure, secret managers.
detection_hint: Indicators of Insufficiently Protected Credentials.

technique: CWE-311 Missing Encryption of Sensitive Data
functional_semantics: Sensitive data stored/sent in the clear.
root_cause: Sensitive data stored/sent in the clear.
fix_pattern: Encrypt at rest and in transit with strong, current algorithms.
detection_hint: Indicators of Missing Encryption of Sensitive Data.

technique: CWE-319 Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Info
functional_semantics: Sensitive data sent over an unencrypted channel.
root_cause: Sensitive data sent over an unencrypted channel.
fix_pattern: Enforce TLS everywhere; HSTS; disable plaintext protocols.
detection_hint: Indicators of Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Info.

technique: CWE-327 Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
fix_pattern: Use vetted current algorithms (AES-GCM, SHA-256+, argon2); crypto-agility.
detection_hint: Indicators of Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm.

functional_semantics: Fast/weak hashing for passwords or integrity.
root_cause: Fast/weak hashing for passwords or integrity.
fix_pattern: Use argon2/bcrypt/scrypt for passwords; SHA-256+ for integrity.
detection_hint: Indicators of Use of Weak Hash.

technique: CWE-330 Use of Insufficiently Random Values
fix_pattern: Use a CSPRNG for anything security-relevant.
detection_hint: Indicators of Use of Insufficiently Random Values.

fix_pattern: Validate chain + hostname + expiry; pin where appropriate; no verify-disable.
detection_hint: Indicators of Improper Certificate Validation.

functional_semantics: A pre-auth session ID is honored after login.
root_cause: A pre-auth session ID is honored after login.
fix_pattern: Regenerate the session ID on authentication; bind sessions.
detection_hint: Indicators of Session Fixation.

fix_pattern: Short-lived tokens, idle+absolute timeouts, revocation.
detection_hint: Indicators of Insufficient Session Expiration.

functional_semantics: Password can be changed without proving identity.
root_cause: Password can be changed without proving identity.
fix_pattern: Require current password / re-auth for credential changes.
detection_hint: Indicators of Unverified Password Change.

fix_pattern: Random single-use time-limited tokens over a verified channel; rate-limit.
detection_hint: Indicators of Weak Password Recovery Mechanism.

technique: CWE-732 Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource
fix_pattern: Least-privilege permissions; deny by default; review ACLs.
detection_hint: Indicators of Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource.

fix_pattern: Ship secure defaults; restrict on creation.
detection_hint: Indicators of Incorrect Default Permissions.

fix_pattern: Least privilege; drop privileges promptly; validate role transitions.
detection_hint: Indicators of Improper Privilege Management.

fix_pattern: Run with minimal privileges; separate duties.
detection_hint: Indicators of Execution with Unnecessary Privileges.

technique: CWE-668 Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere
functional_semantics: A resource is reachable by an unintended actor.
root_cause: A resource is reachable by an unintended actor.
fix_pattern: Scope resources correctly; access control at the boundary.
detection_hint: Indicators of Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere.

technique: CWE-538 Insertion of Sensitive Info into Externally-Accessible File/Dir
fix_pattern: Keep sensitive files out of served paths; restrict access; redact logs.
detection_hint: Indicators of Insertion of Sensitive Info into Externally-Accessible File/Dir.

technique: CWE-532 Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File
fix_pattern: Redact secrets/PII before logging; protect log access.
detection_hint: Indicators of Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File.

technique: CWE-209 Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Info
fix_pattern: Generic error messages in prod; log details server-side only.
detection_hint: Indicators of Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Info.

technique: CWE-611 Improper Restriction of XML External Entity (XXE)
functional_semantics: XML parser resolves external entities -> file read/SSRF.
root_cause: XML parser resolves external entities -> file read/SSRF.
fix_pattern: Disable DTD/external entities in the parser; use safe parsers.
detection_hint: Indicators of Improper Restriction of XML External Entity (XXE).

fix_pattern: Disable entity expansion; limit parser resources.
detection_hint: Indicators of XML Entity Expansion (Billion Laughs).

fix_pattern: Strip/encode CR/LF in header values; use safe header APIs.
detection_hint: Indicators of HTTP Response Splitting.

technique: CWE-601 Open Redirect (URL Redirection to Untrusted Site)
fix_pattern: Allow-list redirect targets; use relative/mapped destinations.
detection_hint: Indicators of Open Redirect (URL Redirection to Untrusted Site).

functional_semantics: Server fetches an attacker URL reaching internal services.
root_cause: Server fetches an attacker URL reaching internal services.
fix_pattern: Allow-list destinations; block internal/link-local + metadata; validate host.
detection_hint: Indicators of Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF).

technique: CWE-116 Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
functional_semantics: Output not neutralized for its sink.
root_cause: Output not neutralized for its sink.
fix_pattern: Context-aware encoding at every sink (HTML/JS/SQL/shell/URL).
detection_hint: Indicators of Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output.

fix_pattern: Strip/encode control chars; validate input.
detection_hint: Indicators of CRLF Injection.

functional_semantics: Untrusted input injected as command arguments/flags.
root_cause: Untrusted input injected as command arguments/flags.
fix_pattern: Allow-list args; separate command from data; avoid shell.
detection_hint: Indicators of Argument Injection.

technique: CWE-134 Use of Externally-Controlled Format String
functional_semantics: User input used as a printf-style format.
root_cause: User input used as a printf-style format.
fix_pattern: Use constant format strings; pass input as arguments only.
detection_hint: Indicators of Use of Externally-Controlled Format String.

functional_semantics: Untrusted input into an LDAP filter.
root_cause: Untrusted input into an LDAP filter.
fix_pattern: Escape/parameterize LDAP filters; validate input.
detection_hint: Indicators of LDAP Injection.

fix_pattern: Encode/validate; use safe builders; schema-validate.
detection_hint: Indicators of XML Injection.

functional_semantics: Untrusted input into an XPath query.
root_cause: Untrusted input into an XPath query.
fix_pattern: Parameterize XPath; validate/encode input.
detection_hint: Indicators of XPath Injection.

functional_semantics: Exported cells start with =,+,-,@ -> spreadsheet code execution.
root_cause: Exported cells start with =,+,-,@ -> spreadsheet code execution.
fix_pattern: Prefix/neutralize leading formula chars on export; validate.
detection_hint: Indicators of Formula Injection (CSV Injection).

functional_semantics: An object accessed as an incompatible type -> memory corruption.
root_cause: An object accessed as an incompatible type -> memory corruption.

detection_hint: Indicators of Type Confusion.

technique: CWE-706 Use of Incorrectly-Resolved Name or Reference
functional_semantics: Name/path resolves to an unintended resource.
root_cause: Name/path resolves to an unintended resource.

fix_pattern: Resolve+validate real paths; O_NOFOLLOW; confine to a base dir.
detection_hint: Indicators of Improper Link Resolution (Link Following).

fix_pattern: Quotas, rate limits, timeouts, backpressure.
detection_hint: Indicators of Uncontrolled Resource Consumption.

technique: CWE-770 Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling
fix_pattern: Cap sizes/counts; validate before allocating.
detection_hint: Indicators of Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling.

technique: CWE-834 Excessive Iteration / Algorithmic Complexity DoS
fix_pattern: Bound iterations; safe regex; complexity limits.
detection_hint: Indicators of Excessive Iteration / Algorithmic Complexity DoS.

fix_pattern: Use linear-time regex engines; simplify patterns; input caps.
detection_hint: Indicators of Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity (ReDoS).

technique: CWE-347 Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature
fix_pattern: Verify signatures with correct keys before trusting data.
detection_hint: Indicators of Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature.

technique: CWE-345 Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity
fix_pattern: MAC/sign + verify; validate provenance.
detection_hint: Indicators of Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity.

fix_pattern: Sign/verify or server-side session state; don't trust client values.
detection_hint: Indicators of Reliance on Cookies Without Validation/Integrity.

functional_semantics: Authorization logic is present but flawed.

detection_hint: Indicators of Incorrect Authorization.

fix_pattern: Anti-CSRF tokens; SameSite cookies; re-auth sensitive actions.
detection_hint: Indicators of Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF).

technique: CWE-1188 Insecure Default Initialization of Resource
